A '''Nano-Counter''' was an explosives timer manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] recommended a Nano-Counter as the best timer to set off a "[[micronite]]" explosive charge.
